_deal: The board's test node, until he plays it.
author: jessica
source: his 2026-11-12 'yeah start' and 'keep going' (one of every type by the 19th): the asteroid survey family (old MB08: fly out and scan, a random box), with the first real use of ask at an object (OT-9J, played as a probe 11-04)
_note: ASTEROID SURVEY: a survey probe left on a rock months ago; he reads it, it shows a rich seam, and he decides who gets the reading.

THE PLAYER'S PART: the choice. Both answers are bad or worse (his CHOICE rule): the office that hired him will strip the rock with a company rig; the prospector who has been asking will work it by hand and pay more, but the office paid for the probe.
Replaces the old payoff (a random box from fifteen) with a decision; his 11-03 worry was exactly 'move to a place and push a button'.
The probe model is the one-beat board's default activator (MB01a's); a survey probe mesh is his or Kim's pick.

2026-11-12, Frances and Kieran (office/contractors/*/reviews/2026-11-12-delve-MB115a.md): both reworks were mostly the sheet: it never showed the probe's choice (ask), the seam or the prospector's note, all on the recipe since it was written (fixed in delve_sheet). Taken: Frances's office states its rig on the always-heard call, so answering the office has a cost; 'someone else might come looking' cut (it called the prospector a thief before she spoke, and Kieran heard a fight). Frances's pick, does the prospector speak: NO, her offer is a note on the probe; a voice needs a second speaker the one-beat board does not have. Kieran's 'the office side needs more than money': the cost is the rock, which is the choice; standing is a later part.
His 2026-11-12 17:43: yes, the prospector stays a note on the probe.
